facts.text: 383 rooms and suites on 15 oceanfront acres. Opened 9 February 1990.
Eight-storey U-shaped building gives most rooms Pacific views. Kahului Airport (OGG) is about 25 minutes away.
Restaurants include Ferraro's (open-air), DUO, Spago (Wolfgang Puck), KOMO and the Lobby Lounge.
KOMO, a 50-seat Japanese restaurant with a 14-seat sushi bar under Chef Kiyokuni Ikeda, was announced in February 2025 and serves dinner Tuesday to Sunday, 5-9pm.
A redesigned 26-room Club Floor with private lounge opened in May 2026, designed by Meyer Davis, as part of a resort-wide transformation.
Filming location for Season 1 of HBO's The White Lotus.
Humpback whales are seen in Maui waters from about November into spring, with the usual peak January to March.

highlights.text: Wailea Beach ranked No. 4 on Dr. Beach's 2026 list of best US beaches.
Three saline pools, including the adults-only Serenity Pool, an infinity-edge pool with underwater music and bubble loungers.

Kai Holo Spa was introduced in July 2026. It has three hydrotherapy pools (vitality, therapeutic hot pool, cold plunge), a steam room, a sensory experience shower, traditional and infrared saunas, a redesigned longevity centre and an infrared Movement Studio.
Kids For All Seasons is complimentary, daily 9am-5pm, for ages 5 and up. Children 4 and under eat free at Ferraro's, DUO, the Lobby Lounge and KOMO with a dining adult.

The Queen's Garden: Uluhaimalama, announced in September 2026, is a cultural experience in the resort's interior courtyard honouring Queen Lili'uokalani, with six self-guided stations on her life and reign, Hawaiian history and traditions. It is open to resort guests, locals and visitors.

considerations.text: Guest-room renovation, under way since March 2026, is not finished: the resort says refreshed guest rooms and suites debut in Q4 2026, so stays this autumn may coincide with construction work. Confirm room status when booking.
Wailea Beach is public by Hawaii law, and reaching it from rooms means walking through the lobby and pool areas.
Entry-level rooms are mountain-side; ocean views mean booking a higher category.
The Serenity Pool is adults-only, so families use the Fountain and Waterfall pools.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily (the standard published rate is room only, with breakfast usually extra).
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers are combinable with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access (the standard published rate charges extra for internet access).
